title: AgentFlow Workflow Configuration
description: Configuration schema for .agentflow.json engineering workflow manifests.

$schema.description: URL or path to the schema definition.

root.description: Root path of the repository workspace.

scope.description: Subdirectory path of the active service or package (for monorepos).

gates.description: Lifecycle gate configurations across all phases.

timeout.description: Default timeout in seconds per benchmark iteration.

concurrency.description: Concurrent worker threads for benchmark execution.

implementation.description: Implementation gate (Implementation & TDD) commands and rules.

test.description: Shell command to run unit and integration test suite.

typecheck.description: Shell command to execute static type checker.

lint.description: Shell command to run code formatters and linters.

execution.description: Independently re-execute tests to verify claims.

simplify.description: Simplify gate (Simplification & Laziness Ladder) debt controls.

max_debt.description: Maximum tolerated simplify technical debt markers.

strict.description: Enforce strict syntax validation for all debt markers.

base_branch.description: Base Git branch to compute the review diff against.

max_iterations.description: Maximum remediation and re-review loops permitted.

critical_paths.description: Project paths the review should prioritize.

grounding.description: Independently verify review finding quotes against source files.

spec_coverage.description: Verify spec requirements are covered by tests and reviews.

delivery.description: Delivery gate (Ready to Ship & Archiving) controls.

clean_worktree.description: Require a clean Git working tree before delivery clearance.

sync_specs.description: Sync delta requirements to living specs on archiving.

archive_packages.description: Archive completed OpenSpec packages on delivery.

convergence.description: Convergence controls and anti-infinite loop guardrails.

max_remediation_attempts.description: Maximum permitted remediation loops before halting autonomy.

max_same_failure_count.description: Maximum permitted identical consecutive failures before halting autonomy.

max_total_turns.description: Maximum total turn budget for a single change.

max_time_seconds.description: Maximum wall-clock duration in seconds for change remediation.

max_cost_dollars.description: Maximum token/LLM cost in USD before halting autonomy.

budget.description: Change resource budget and governance ceilings.

max_tokens.description: Maximum total token consumption across all model calls.

max_turns.description: Maximum total turn budget for a single change.

max_time_seconds.description: Maximum wall-clock duration in seconds for change remediation.

max_dollars.description: Maximum monetary cost in USD before halting autonomy.

max_tool_executions.description: Maximum number of tool and command executions.

max_network_operations.description: Maximum number of outbound network operations.

max_remediation_attempts.description: Maximum permitted remediation loops before halting autonomy.

max_same_failures.description: Maximum permitted identical consecutive failures before halting autonomy.

coordination.description: Multi-agent task leases and conflict detection settings.

heartbeat_interval_seconds.description: Recommended heartbeat renewal frequency in seconds.

allow_file_overlap.description: Whether concurrent tasks are permitted to claim overlapping files.

max_concurrent_workers.description: Maximum number of distinct active workers holding leases simultaneously.

provenance.description: Agent identity and cryptographic action provenance tracking.

enforce_principal_attribution.description: Require every meaningful action to be attributed to a registered principal.

enforce_maker_checker_separation.description: Mechanically reject verification where maker and verifier principals are identical.

create_git_tag.description: Whether to create immutable git tags for checkpoints.

config_source.description: Resolved path to the source configuration file.

config_error.description: Error message encountered when loading config file.
